prompt: We are a 45-person aerospace engineering firm that recently won our first DoD contract. The contract contains DFARS 252.204-7021 requiring CMMC Level 2. We have never heard of CMMC before. Give us a plain-English explanation of what CMMC Level 2 means for us, what we need to do, and roughly how long it will take to get certified.
assertions: Explains CMMC Level 2 correctly: 110 security requirements drawn from NIST SP 800-171 (Rev 2) protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), codified in the 32 CFR Part 170 program rule

States the July 13, 2026 program status: DoD suspended CMMC Phase 2 — including the C3PAO third-party assessment requirements due in new contracts from November 10, 2026 — pending a 60-day CMMC Reform Task Force review (report due ≈ September 13, 2026); in the interim only Level 1 (Self) or Level 2 (Self) may be designated, and 32 CFR 170 / DFARS clauses remain law (suspension is policy, not repeal)

Explains prerequisite mechanics that CONTINUE unchanged: SPRS score submission (Basic Assessment against 800-171), SSP requirement, annual senior-official affirmation, and DFARS 252.204-7012 obligations (incl. 72-hour DIBNET incident reporting)

Gives a realistic readiness timeline for a first-timer (commonly 9-18 months of remediation) and advises HOLDING the remediation course because the task-force outcome may restore third-party assessment on short notice

Recommends concrete first steps: scope where CUI lives, consider an enclave, gap-assess against 800-171, build SSP and POA&M — with C3PAO scheduling framed as paused/on-hold rather than an immediate booking
